entry.title: A successful deployment is not a verified release
entry.summary: Separate source, artifacts, deployment, and user outcomes; rehearse rollback with data compatibility in mind.

entry.title: “Support export” is not an acceptance criterion
entry.summary: Use an export workflow to separate acceptance scenarios, interface boundaries, and architecture decisions.

entry.title: Green tests are not enough: design quality gates around failure paths
entry.summary: Prioritize logic, integration, end-to-end, security, and accessibility checks by the failures they detect.

entry.title: Low CPU, failed users: connect service indicators to incident learning
entry.summary: Distinguish accepted requests from completed jobs, define indicator populations, and make incident actions verifiable.
